title: Scaling limit theorem for mixed free and Boolean convolution powers
summary: We prove a scaling limit theorem for a double sequence of probability measures involving additive free convolution $\boxplus$ and additive Boolean convolution $\uplus$. Let $μ$ be a probability measure on $\mathbb{R}$ with mean zero and variance one, and let $M=M(N)>0$ satisfy $MN^{α+1/2}\to t>0$. We study the weak limits, as $N\to \infty$, of the double arrays $D_{N^α}((μ^{\boxplus N})^{\uplus M})$.
